Hadith.4497 - Abd al-Hamid narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said: "
A blind woman, a woman with vitiligo, a woman with leprosy, and a lame woman can be returned (marriage contract can be annulled due to these conditions)."
